function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a way to pull the *lowest* score from the tracker – the function we have (`game_tracker_high_score`) only reports the highest score for a given game, platform, and user.

In Flappy Bird, the score starts at 0 and increases as you pass each pipe, so the theoretical minimum score you can achieve is 0. If you’re looking for the lowest score ever recorded by a particular player or on a particular platform, that information isn’t available through the current API.
